exposure: exposure to pets in childhood (cat and dog)
mold exposure in housing during childhood
living on a farm during childhood
cohort: The study included 25,251 adult French women from the NutriNet-Sante web-based cohort, who completed a self-administered questionnaire on perinatal and childhood exposures in 2019.
finding: Endometriosis/adenomyosis was positively associated with low birth weight, maternal smoking during pregnancy, daycare attendance, exposure to pets in childhood, and mold exposure in housing during childhood, while living on a farm and having farmer parents were inversely associated.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was not associated with endometriosis/adenomyosis.
birth_weight: low birth weight (<2500 g) and normal birth weight (>=2500 g) were used as an exposure, relating to the participants' own birth weight.
